main.description: Immutable canonical provenance hop recorded in the official Give a Thing repository (@giveathing.com) whenever a thing is pulled, gifted, or claimed.

thing.description: Strong reference to the canonical com.giveathing.thing record.

prevEntry.description: Strong reference to the previous com.giveathing.ledger record in this thing's provenance chain.

sequenceNum.description: 0 for initial discovery pull, incrementing by 1 on every transfer.

owner.description: DID of the recipient/holder at this step.

previousOwner.description: DID of the sender (omitted on sequenceNum 0).

note.description: Optional permanent gift note attached by the sender.

userProof.description: Strong reference to the sender's com.giveathing.transfer or recipient's com.giveathing.claim record.
